title: metadata-protocol: deleting an own-package object_extension that re-declared a stored expression leaves stored values stale
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwJbS8sZAfru2iyvQq

Filing gate: ① product defect, class a. Found by the contract review of PR #32921 (record 6839282932, ④.2), read from the code on `main`. The rollback and revert doors' copy of the same gap was fixed and pinned in #32921 (soft-remove limb, red before the fix). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.
reach: `DELETE /api/v1/meta/object_extension/:name` (the `deleteMetaItem` door) for an own-package `object_extension` that re-declared a stored computed field's expression.

## What happens

`deleteMetaItem` removes the extension, and the object's effective definition falls back to the base expression. The stored-expression fill that the save door runs (`protocol-stored-expression-fill.ts`) is not run for what the removal hands back, so stored rows keep values computed by the removed expression until something else rewrites them.

## Expected

The same as the save door and, since #32921, rollback and revert: capture before the registry view is restored, then fill what the removal changed. The answer carries the fill's advisories.

## Business reason

A tenant who removes a customization of a computed field sees the old formula's numbers on every existing record, with nothing saying they are stale.

## Also noted (same review, prose only)

`object-storage-sync-refused` now also rides rollback and revert answers, but its text still speaks of "this save" and "publish the object again".

Dedupe words: `deleteMetaItem stored expression fill`, `object_extension delete stale stored value`, `stored computed field removal backfill`.
Related: #32700 (PR #32921), #32690.
